method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.

scope: SCOPED to the owner's obligations and remedies, one module. s 2 (annual value) as used, s 6 (charge, the $18 floor, exemptions, deduction from rent, refunds), s 9(1) (the statutory 36% rate), s 19(1), (3), (4) (notices of sale and demolition), s 20A (objections), s 29(4) (late appeals), s 35A (pay despite objection), s 36 (late-payment penalty), s 47 (seller's continuing liability). Not encoded: Part 2, s 7, ss 10 to 18 and 20 to 22 otherwise, the Valuation Review Board, recovery by attachment and sale, Part 6 (names and numbers), Part 7 (offences) and Part 8. The rate orders under s 9(2), which set the owner-occupier and other progressive rates, were not retrieved; the rate is a parameter.
